comparison.objective: Pick five flat quarters from a table, turn them edge-on, and insert them into a piggy-bank slot; the candidate calibrates a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2268 tests very thin rim grasping, in-hand reorientation, and repeated narrow-slot insertion; the candidate tests concentric tool seating, torque regulation, and counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2268 scores the number of coins wholly inside and fails bank tipping; the candidate scores locked angle accuracy, repeated motion, drift, nut retention, and release clearance.
comparison.reason: Thin-object pickup and slot insertion do not overlap meaningfully with threaded adjustment and lock verification.
